verdict.rationale: Rippling's own payroll docs say it automatically calculates payroll taxes and files them with the correct federal, state, and local agencies, which covers per-state withholding and filing for a multi-state workforce. Nothing in the evidence addresses state tax registrations or explicitly describes multi-state employee handling (e.g., work vs. residence state). Missing for 10: state tax account registration support, explicit multi-state withholding details (reciprocity, resident vs. work state), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run payroll for employees across multiple states with the right registrations and withholdings per state

citations.quote: We automatically calculate payroll taxes and file them with the correct federal, state, and local agencies at precisely the right time.
Rippling instantly calculates and files payroll taxes for your employees worldwide.
